import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

entries=[]
for launch_file, completion_file, root in [
 ('qwen38_selected_test.json','qwen38_selected_test_completion.json','qwen38-selected-test-v1'),
 ('qwen38_b4_validation.json','qwen38_b4_validation_completion.json','qwen38-b4-validation-v1'),
 ('qwen38_primary_grpo_validation.json','qwen38_primary_grpo_validation_completion.json','qwen38-primary-grpo-validation-v1')]:
    launch_path=Path('results/training')/launch_file
    completion_path=Path('results/training')/completion_file
    launch=json.loads(launch_path.read_text()); completed=json.loads(completion_path.read_text())
    assert launch['status']=='outputs_retrieved'
    log=next((Path('results/kaggle')/root).glob('*.log'))
    assert 'Evaluation worker exit codes:' in log.read_text()
    for p, h in completed['downloaded_files'].items():
        assert file_sha256(p)==h['sha256']
    entries.append({'kernel':launch['metadata']['id'],'version':launch['version'],
      'terminal_status':launch['polls'][-1]['output'],'download_receipt':str(launch_path),
      'download_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(launch_path),'completion_receipt':str(completion_path),
      'completion_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(completion_path),'log':str(log),'log_sha256':file_sha256(log),
      'cause':'Registered script wall deadline exhausted; wrapper killed evaluation worker. No out-of-memory error appears in the downloaded log.',
      'pair_runtime':completed['pair_runtime'], 'cohorts':completed['cohorts'],
      'runtime_caution':'A hard-killed worker cannot flush its final runtime/VRAM; use complete wrapper wall time, not its stale loading snapshot.'})
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Diagnose all three reported Kaggle ERROR versions from downloaded terminal artifacts'}),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'kernels':entries}
Path('results/training/qwen38_terminal_errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_test_finish')
meta=json.loads((folder/'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
meta.update(id='nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-qwen38-test-finish',title='MakeMarketBench Qwen38 test finish')
(folder/'kernel-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
selection_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json')
selection=json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
q=snapshot['quota']; available=q['gpu_seconds_total']-q['gpu_seconds_used']-q['gpu_seconds_reserved']
assert available>=840
prefix_root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-selected-test-v1')/selection['label']/'results/raw'
plan={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'ONE bounded missing-only continuation authorized by finish-now directive'},selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
      'status':'registered_before_submission','selection_file':str(selection_path),'selection_sha256':file_sha256(selection_path),
      'adapter_sha256':selection['adapter_sha256'],'metadata':meta,'source_sha256':file_sha256(folder/meta['code_file']),
      'session_timeout_seconds':840,'script_budget_seconds':780,'quota_snapshot':snapshot,'available_seconds':available,
      'fixed_policy':{'label':selection['label'],'training_seed':0,'evaluation_seed':200,'episodes_per_game':200,'batch_size':4,'decoder':'greedy'},
      'prefix_sha256':{g:file_sha256(prefix_root/g/f"{selection['label']}.jsonl") for g in ('dice','cards')},
      'episodes_saved':{'dice':200,'cards':192},'only_missing_seeds':{'dice':[],'cards':list(range(392,400))},
      'runtime_estimate':{'loading_seconds_observed':300.52679109573364,'last_two_complete_groups_seconds':[155.327,173.154],'expected_missing_groups':2,
        'basis':'Downloaded test loading snapshot and final complete group timestamps. Reference evaluation and reporting add seconds; 780-second script cap is a bound, not a completion guarantee.'},
      'checkpointing':'Existing runner atomically persists every complete four-episode group in /kaggle/working. Prefix and cached greedy responses restored; only missing groups acquired.',
      'stop_rule':'No second rerun. If incomplete, retain exact partial n, score only complete games, and stop. Optional validation finish jobs are skipped.',
      'build_command':'.venv/bin/python train/build_kaggle_kernel.py --qwen38-evaluate --evaluation-split test --evaluate-adapter sft --newest-batch-size 4 --evaluation-budget-seconds 780 --evaluation-resume-kernel nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-qwen38-batch4-test --out runs/kaggle_qwen38_test_finish'}
Path('results/training/qwen38_test_finish_plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('ITERATIONS.md')
p.write_text(p.read_text()+'''\n### T39 — terminal artifact recovery and one bounded test continuation\n\n- Diagnose all three reported Kaggle ERROR versions using saved logs, raw episodes, wrapper deadlines and hashes: `results/training/qwen38_terminal_errors.json`. Each worker reaches its registered script deadline, rather than reporting GPU OOM. The selected test retains all 200 dice and 192 cards episodes; do not score partial cards.\n- The official November 1 quota query reports 107102.574 of 108000 GPU seconds used, 897.426 seconds free, reset November 7. This is the current weekly account receipt, superseding assumed calendar resets.\n- Hypothesis: restoring acquired groups and cached responses can finish the final eight cards episodes with the frozen adapter/greedy batch-four policy in one 780-second script / 840-second private saved session. Estimated loading 301 seconds plus two observed roughly 155–173-second groups. Exact source, quota, seed prefix and selection hashes: `results/training/qwen38_test_finish_plan.json`.\n- Change only execution continuity: no training, seed selection, decoder change or new candidate. Atomically checkpoint complete raw groups. Run once; retain any remaining partial and stop. Skip both optional validation continuations under the owner's finish-now priority.\n''')
print('Verified all downloaded error artifacts; registered one 840-second continuation.')
